basic_info.headline: Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase | Building AI agents on Amazon Bedrock
basic_info.about:
I'm a software engineer focused on making builds faster, more reliable, and easier to fix when they break.
Built an AI diagnostic agent on Amazon Bedrock that automatically diagnoses failed CI/CD pipelines. It reads the build logs, finds the failing step and the root cause, works out whether the failure came from the user's code or the platform, and recommends a fix. It monitors thousands of repositories continuously, so engineers get an explanation as soon as a build fails instead of digging through logs themselves.
Before that, I helped develop a modern CI/CD pipeline to replace Jenkins, built with Starlark, Go, and Bazel. I engineered cross-platform pipeline logic that runs on environments like GitHub Actions, built core tooling support for Maven, Gradle, and Python projects, and helped cut average build times across firm-wide projects by 50%, from 5 minutes to 2.5.
I've also used Gradle Enterprise to reduce time-to-market by up to 50%, maintained build pipelines to improve reliability, and caught code quality issues early in development. On Jules Pipeline and Kubernetes, I've deployed and managed microservices in highly scalable, highly available environments, with automated scaling to optimize resource usage.
I taught myself Python through online resources, building games and chatbots, and I still bring that same curiosity to every project. I care about delivering high-quality results and helping teams work well together.

experience.title: Software Engineer
experience.description:
•Developed a modern CI/CD pipeline to replace Jenkins, leveraging Starlark, Go, and Bazel for improved performance, portability, and extensibility.
•Engineered cross-platform pipeline logic using Go binaries, enabling seamless execution on environments like GitHub Actions.
•Built core tooling support for Maven, Gradle, and Python projects, facilitating smooth onboarding and consistent builds across diverse codebases.
•Achieved 50% average build time reduction across firm-wide projects, cutting typical build durations from 5 minutes to 2.5 minutes.
• Built an AI diagnostic agent on Amazon Bedrock (Claude) that automatically diagnoses failed CI/CD pipelines: it reads build logs, pinpoints the failing step and root cause, determines whether the failure came from user code or the platform, and recommends a fix.
• Automated continuous monitoring across 100,000+ repositories, so failures are diagnosed as they happen instead of waiting for manual triage.
• Added build-parity checks comparing the new pipeline against legacy Jenkins builds, flagging differences early to de-risk the migration.
